text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After suffering consecutive defeats in 
races, I returned to the waiting room, 
and—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Last time... yes, that's where things 
fell apart. But the issue this time was—"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
The factors preventing us from making full 
use of the method still exist... I need to 
scrutinize all recent races—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry, Trainer. I went off into my 
own world again...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, I seem to have shown you an 
unsightly side of myself again today."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Behind every glorious history lies bitter 
defeat... Even so, my recent race record 
is hardly anything to be proud of...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"At this rate, I won't be able to face the 
great seniors who built our racing 
history—"
choice_data_list:
There's still plenty of time to turn this 
around!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"At this rate, I won't be able to face the 
great seniors who built our racing 
history—"
choice_data_list:
There's still plenty of time to turn this 
around!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...You're not... going to scold me...?
choice_data_list:
I'm sure you've already scolded yourself 
enough.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: That is... yes...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
However, seeing such a sorry state... 
Surely as a Trainer, you'd want to have a 
word—
choice_data_list:
Instead of scolding, I want to help you 
take that step forward.

Rather than scold you, I'd rather help you 
move forward.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Trainer...-san...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much... Please continue to 
lend me your assistance going forward.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
This time for sure... This time for 
sure... Victory will be in my grasp...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: R-Right, of course...
choice_data_list: Don't try to shoulder it all on your own!

You shouldn't keep it all bottled up by 
yourself!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Yes! ...Huh?
choice_data_list:
It's no good to start dwelling on your 
mistakes all by yourself.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...!
choice_data_list: I wanna be mixed in properly too!
Make sure you mix me in properly too!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Um... Y-Yes, understood...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I... suppose you're right. It wasn't just 
me... The two of us took on that race 
together, after all...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Let us combine our strengths, devise 
improvements... and win next time...!
